shared_elements: human figure represented in low relief on stone
suggestion of arms/hands across the body
justification: Both depict human forms in relief with schematically rendered heads and hands indicated across the torso, and B has a raised disc motif comparable to the round vessels held in A, but this is generic. A is a narrative frieze of a repeated procession of profile figures in patterned robes carrying vessels toward a seated/standing recipient above a rosette band, whereas B is a single frontal, massive block-like torso with isolated schematic carved symbols on its back and no scene, procession or narrative relation.
